policy: No owner photography was generated, sourced externally, or modified during the original gallery redesign; existing owner photographs and collection media retain their original files and content IDs. The later generated brand icon and public-domain Paintings extension are recorded separately below.

opening.origin: Pre-existing owner-provided opening photograph; responsive variants hero/launch-800.webp, hero/launch-1600.webp, hero/launch-2400.webp already existed.
Pre-existing photograph 08 in the owner collection; used as a satellite and opening-view alternative.
Pre-existing photograph 09 in the owner collection; used as a satellite and opening-view alternative.

fonts.origin: Pre-existing self-hosted Calistoga font in the repository; newly enabled for gallery display typography.

icons: Interface controls use original authored SVG line geometry in index.html and js/atelier.js; no third-party icon library. Website favicon and Apple Touch Icon use the generated brand icon recorded below.

brandIcon.origin: Generated with the built-in image_gen tool for N1GHT CHXN9: cobalt enamel tile, ivory N monogram and crescent. No source photographs used.
brandIcon.processing: Pillow Lanczos downsampling; ICO includes 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256 pixel frames. Apple Touch Icon is flattened on #f8faff; other PNGs retain transparency. Existing night-mark assets preserved.

paintings.origin: Twelve real world-famous paintings reproduced from Wikimedia Commons; each work's source page, download URL, public-domain rights and dimensions are recorded in the manifest.
paintings.processing: Original aspect ratio and colour retained. Twelve locally resized WebP main images with a longest edge of approximately 1280–2000px, plus twelve 240px thumbnails; 24 files total 9,507,050 bytes.
paintings.embeddedProvenance: Every shipping WebP embeds its source and public-domain rights in XMP metadata.
paintings.loading: Main images are prepared on first entry and selection, with the next work preloaded; catalogue thumbnails are lazy-loaded. The homepage does not immediately load all main images.

exports: PNG files are generated by the existing local Canvas workflows from the visitor's selected collection items.
